title: Swim Mom Funny Shirt, Chaotic Swim Meet Tee, Retro Badge Design, Gift for Swim Team Mom
description:
For the mom who's run on cold coffee and pool deck fumes since 6 a.m. This retro badge design brings a fresh, bold graphic to the usual swim mom shirt lineup.

The distressed screen-print look and sunburst badge stand out at a glance, while the humor hits exactly how every swim season actually feels.

A comfy, true-to-size tee perfect for meet days, carpool lines, and everything in between. Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
risk_notes: Original badge artwork and wording with no references to existing trademarked phrases.
